claims.claim: When correlated assets are sufficiently correlated, endogenous information in trades produces multiple equilibria ranked by volume and efficiency, and post-trade transparency can raise or lower welfare and volume.

claims.supporting_quote: We show that this endogeneity leads to multiple equilibria when assets are sufficiently correlated.
